source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 2 同主题完形(餐桌上的误会/一个汉字的故事/手势课/时间观念/英美用词卡片/打招呼语的由来)。用词限 U2/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: A Funny Meal Abroad
passages.text: On my first trip to America, a small word almost spoiled my lunch. My friend asked me whether I wanted to (1)____ some "French fries". I had no (2)____ what they were, so I just smiled. When the waiter came, he put a (3)____ of hot chips in front of me. I was (4)____ to learn that "fries" and "chips" were the same food. Later we were given "biscuits", but they did not (5)____ sweet at all; they were salty and soft. My friend (6)____ that in America "biscuits" are savoury snacks. I felt a little (7)____ about all my mistakes, but she told me it was not my (8)____. The same (9)____ is spoken in our two countries, yet the words can be quite different. By the end of the meal, we were both (10)____ at how funny language can be.

questions.explanation: order food 点餐。
have no idea 不知道。
a plate of chips 一盘薯条。
amazed to learn 惊讶地得知。
taste sweet 尝起来甜(系动词)。
explained that 解释说。
feel embarrassed 感到尴尬。
not my fault 不是我的错。
the same language 同一种语言。
laughing at how funny 笑语言多有趣。

passages.title: The Story of One Word
passages.text: My Chinese teacher loves to tell us the (1)____ behind a single word. One day she taught us "chi", which simply (2)____ "to eat". But she said the word often goes far beyond its (3)____ meaning. For example, "chi cu" sounds like eating vinegar, but it really (4)____ to be jealous. We were all (5)____ to hear that. She also told us that "chi moshui" does not mean eating ink; it (6)____ to receiving an education. I learned that we should not always take a word (7)____. Behind such a small word (8)____ a whole way of thinking. Now, whenever I meet a new Chinese word, I try to find the (9)____ hidden inside it. Learning these expressions has made the (10)____ much more interesting to me.

questions.explanation: the story behind 背后的故事。
means "to eat" 意为。
literal meaning 字面意思。
means to be jealous 意为嫉妒。
amazed to hear 惊讶地听到。
refers to 指的是。
take a word literally 按字面理解。
behind … lies … 在……背后有(倒装)。
the meaning hidden inside 隐藏的含义。
made the language interesting 让语言有趣。

passages.title: A Lesson on Gestures
passages.text: Today our teacher gave us a fun (1)____ on body language. She said that a gesture is a kind of (2)____, just like words. Most of us think that shaking the head always (3)____ "no", but she told us this is not true everywhere. In some places, the same gesture can carry the (4)____ meaning. A careless traveller may send the (5)____ message and cause a small misunderstanding. So before you visit a new country, it is (6)____ to learn how local people use their hands. The teacher also said that a friendly (7)____ seems to mean the same warm thing almost everywhere. We were all (8)____ by how much a single movement can say. After the (9)____, I felt that learning gestures is part of learning a (10)____.

questions.explanation: a fun lesson 有趣的一课。
a kind of language 一种语言。
means "no" 意为'不'。
the opposite meaning 相反的意思。
the wrong message 错误的信息。
it is wise to 明智的做法。
a friendly smile 友好的微笑。
amazed by 被……惊到。
after the lesson 课后。
learning a culture 学习一种文化。

passages.title: A New Sense of Time
passages.text: After I moved to a small town abroad, my (1)____ towards time slowly changed. At home, I used to (2)____ if I was even five minutes late. People around me, however, were much more (3)____ about the clock. When a shop owner said he would help me "soon", he did not (4)____ it literally; "soon" could mean in an hour or even the next day. At first this made me (5)____, because I expected things to happen at once. But over the months my (6)____ towards being late changed a lot. I am still (7)____ on time for important appointments, but when I am a little late, I no longer (8)____. Living here has taught (9)____ a new way to look at time. Ironically, I now feel that I live more in the (10)____ moment than ever before.

questions.explanation: attitude towards time 对时间的态度。
panic if late 迟到就慌。
relaxed about the clock 对时间放松。
mean it literally 按字面意思理解。
made me anxious 让我焦虑(系动词后形容词)。
my attitude 我的态度。
usually on time 通常准时。
no longer panic 不再惊慌。
taught me 教会了我(间接宾语)。
the present moment 当下时刻。

passages.title: Word Cards for Two Englishes
passages.text: To remember the differences between British and American English, I made some word (1)____. On each card I wrote a British word on one side and the American word on the (2)____. For example, the British say "petrol" while Americans (3)____ "gas". A British "flat" is an American "apartment", and a British "biscuit" is an American "cookie". These are not (4)____; they are just two ways of speaking the same language. At first the differences (5)____ me, but the cards helped a lot. Now, whenever I am not (6)____ which word someone means, I simply ask in a (7)____ way. My English teacher was (8)____ that I had made so many cards by myself. She said that paying attention to such (9)____ would make me a better speaker. Step by step, I have grown more (10)____ when I talk with people from different countries.

questions.explanation: word cards 单词卡片。
on the other (side) 另一面。
Americans say "gas" 美国人说。
not mistakes 不是错误。
confused me 让我困惑。
not sure 不确定。
in a polite way 礼貌地。
amazed that 惊讶于。
such differences 这些差异。
more confident 更自信。

passages.title: Where Greetings Come From
passages.text: Many everyday greetings have a surprising (1)____. Take the Italian word "ciao", which people now use to (2)____ hello or goodbye. Long ago, it came from a phrase whose literal (3)____ was "I am your slave". Of course, no one (4)____ it that way today; its real meaning is friendly and warm. The English word "hello" also has an interesting (5)____. It is said to come from an old French word that roughly (6)____ "whoa there!". Over time the word slowly (7)____ into the friendly greeting we know now. These small facts show that words can (8)____ greatly over the years. When we learn where a greeting comes from, we understand the (9)____ behind it a little better. For me, this is the most (10)____ part of studying a language.

questions.explanation: a surprising origin 令人惊讶的由来。
mean hello 表示你好。
literal translation 字面译文。
takes it that way 那样理解。
an interesting history 有趣的来历。
roughly means 大致意思是。
grew into 逐渐变成。
change greatly 变化很大。
the culture behind it 背后的文化。
the most exciting part 最激动人心的部分。
